scope: Epoch-bound E2EE authorization for membership, device and block changes, with one shared fail-closed conversation privacy gate

controls.wire_storage_mode: e2ee_v1 retained for backward-compatible message classification
controls.block_rotation_scope: shared conversations in the affected profile only
controls.block_policy: shared fail-closed gate across E2EE/plaintext send and replay, read, delivery, media, typing, meetings and calls
controls.group_block_behavior: freeze the conversation until the relationship or membership is resolved
controls.encrypted_nonce_binding: canonical commitment covers sender device, expiry, attachment and every ordered ciphertext envelope
controls.transactional_recheck: BEGIN IMMEDIATE rechecks block, nonce, key epoch and device set before insert

resolved_findings.finding: Profile block initially stopped E2EE only; plaintext send/read and known attachment URLs could bypass it.
resolved_findings.resolution: One conversation block policy now gates all message, media and realtime/call surfaces, including transaction-time send rechecks.

resolved_findings.finding: A pending direct request omitted its pending recipient from block evaluation and could still be read or accepted.
resolved_findings.resolution: Pending direct participants are included in block policy; direct and group invitation acceptance recheck blocks atomically.

resolved_findings.finding: A real block/unblock incremented a global victim epoch and could churn unrelated conversations.
resolved_findings.resolution: Block rotation is scoped to shared conversations in the affected profile; an unrelated-conversation regression test is required.

resolved_findings.finding: Encrypted nonce replay was not bound to sender device, expiry or ciphertext envelopes.
resolved_findings.resolution: A stored canonical encrypted request commitment and locked replay check reject any changed replay as nonce_conflict.

resolved_findings.finding: Legacy over-limit device rows were parsed before the sentinel count check and malformed JWK JSON could throw a 500.
resolved_findings.resolution: Cardinality is checked before parsing; in-limit invalid stored keys return a bounded ready:false device_set_invalid response.

resolved_findings.finding: Legacy E2EE decrypt compatibility was claimed only by static inspection.
resolved_findings.resolution: A real V1 ECDH/HKDF/AES-GCM/AAD ciphertext now roundtrips after epoch migration, while new unbound encryption is rejected.

external_release_gates: trusted-HTTPS real device and browser lifecycle lab

capacity.reason: Capacity telemetry is unobserved; one bounded local packet plus one sequential independent checker
